sample_query: WITH s AS (SELECT id,pub_time,content,stk_code,notice_type_new,url FROM public.news_notice WHERE pub_time < %s ORDER BY pub_time DESC,id DESC,url DESC LIMIT 1000) SELECT count(*) AS sampled,min(pub_time) AS first_publication,max(pub_time) AS last_publication,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(content),'') IS NULL) AS empty_content,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(stk_code),'') IS NULL) AS empty_code,count(*) FILTER(WHERE notice_type_new IS NULL) AS empty_new_type,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(url),'') IS NULL) AS empty_link FROM s
company_query: SELECT stk_code,count(*) AS documents,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(content),'') IS NULL) AS empty_content FROM public.news_notice WHERE pub_time>='2026-07-01' AND pub_time<'2026-10-02' AND stk_code IN ('688981','002594','600519','300750') GROUP BY stk_code ORDER BY stk_code
